summary: Build climate risk, ESG controls, and board-ready reporting skills in 5 days. Learn practical frameworks and apply them to real scenarios.
lede: Climate and ESG risk management helps risk, sustainability, finance and governance professionals identify and assess material climate exposures. Participants practice prioritizing ESG issues, analyzing climate scenarios, designing risk treatments and controls, and preparing disclosure and board-reporting materials such as risk registers, scenario worksheets and control matrices.
audienceIntro: This advanced climate and ESG risk management course is designed for professionals who already work with risk, sustainability, disclosure, finance, or governance processes and need to strengthen how they assess climate exposure, design controls, and report material issues.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of enterprise risk, sustainability, finance, audit, or strategy processes. Familiarity with risk registers, materiality concepts, and basic climate or ESG terminology will help you move faster; no coding is required, but comfort using spreadsheets and dashboard-based reporting is expected. Advanced concepts are taught at operational application level, with AI-assisted analytics and automation covered through practical examples rather than programming or model-building.
